meta.title: Four number-line questions · संख्या रेखा
meta.instructions: Enter the number of integer solutions. Each question is worth one mark. Original practice by ModuMath.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text:
कितने पूर्णांक x के लिए |2x − 1| < 7 है?

How many integers x satisfy |2x − 1| < 7?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text:
अब |2x − 1| ≤ 7 के लिए कितने पूर्णांक x हैं?

Change the sign to ≤. How many integers x satisfy |2x − 1| ≤ 7?
questions.explanation: −3 ≤ x ≤ 4. Both endpoints now belong, giving two more integers.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text:
कितने पूर्णांक x के लिए |x − 1| + |x − 4| = 3 है?

How many integers x have a total distance of 3 from 1 and 4 on the number line?
questions.explanation: Every point in [1, 4] has total distance 3. The integers are 1, 2, 3 and 4.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text:
यदि दूरियों का योग 5 हो, तो कितने पूर्णांक x मिलेंगे?

Now count the integers satisfying |x − 1| + |x − 4| = 5.
questions.explanation: Between the endpoints the sum is 3. Each unit outside increases the sum by 2. The two solutions are 0 and 5.
